6. Alternative Flows and Exceptions
Unrecognized Document 
(Alternative Flow)
Trigger: 
A document fails to match any 
existing supplier template.
Action: 
System routes the document to an 
“Unrecognised” queue. An Opera-
tor must manually classify and 
train Scan2x to recognise this new 
invoice layout in the future.
Data Extraction Errors
(Alternative Flow)
Trigger: 
Essential fields (e.g., invoice total) 
are missing or incorrectly read.
Action: 
The Operator receives a notifica-
tion to review and correct the 
data within Scan2x before pro-
ceeding. Once corrected, normal 
workflow continues. 
7. Postconditions
Successful Posting
•
All invoices have been processed, normalised, and transferred to the downstream 
system.
•
Users can view a confirmation log and audit trail within Scan2x.
•
The downstream system reflects the new invoice entries ready for payment or 
further workflow steps.
Error Handling and Notifications
•
Any invoices flagged during the process remain in a review queue until resolved.
•
All errors are logged, and relevant personnel are alerted.
System Integration 
Failure (Exception)
Trigger: 
Network 
connectivity 
or 
API 
issues prevent posting to the 
downstream system.
Action: 
Scan2x queues the data and 
retries periodically. If repeated 
failures occur, the Operator is 
alerted for manual intervention.
